positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Developed computer vision models (CNNs, YOLO) for object detection, lane tracking, and environment perception, improving detection accuracy by 25% on autonomous driving datasets.
Built and trained predictive models for vehicle battery health, range estimation, and failure prediction using LSTM and XGBoost, reducing prediction error by 20%.
Designed and deployed real-time inference services using FastAPI, Docker, and Kubernetes, enabling sub-100ms model responses for onboard and edge deployments.
Built data pipelines with Apache Spark, Kafka, and Airflow to ingest and process sensor, telemetry, and vision data, improving training data availability by 40%.
Integrated MLflow and model registry workflows to track experiments, version models, and automate retraining, reducing manual MLOps effort by 35%.
Implemented model monitoring for drift detection and performance degradation, reducing production incidents by 30% through proactive alerting.
Collaborated with vehicle engineering, software, and data teams to translate requirements into ML solutions, delivering 10+ AI features into production vehicle platforms.

positions.title: AI/ML Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed end-to-end ML solutions for enterprise clients across manufacturing, retail, and financial services, delivering 8+ production models.
Built predictive maintenance models using LSTM and time-series analysis on IoT sensor data, reducing unplanned downtime by 25% for client manufacturing operations.
Developed demand forecasting and anomaly detection models using XGBoost and scikit-learn, improving forecast accuracy by 20% for retail and supply chain clients.
Built NLP-based automation for document classification and information extraction using spaCy, Transformers, and Hugging Face, reducing manual processing by 40%.
Designed and deployed MLOps pipelines with MLflow, Airflow, and Docker, reducing model deployment time by 40% and enabling automated retraining.
Created data pipelines with Apache Spark and SQL to process large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, improving data quality and reducing processing time by 30%.
Collaborated with client teams and internal stakeholders to translate business requirements into ML solutions across multiple engagements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software and data solutions for automotive manufacturing operations, supporting production planning, quality tracking, and operational reporting.
Built Python and SQL-based automation tools for production data collection, validation, and reporting, reducing manual effort by 35% across manufacturing lines.
Developed analytics dashboards using Power BI and Tableau to track production KPIs, quality metrics, and downtime, improving visibility for plant operations teams.
Created SQL-based data models and ETL workflows to consolidate data from manufacturing systems, improving data consistency and reporting accuracy by 25%.
Automated recurring reports and data validation checks using Python scripts, saving 15+ hours of manual effort weekly across operations teams.
Collaborated with production, quality, and IT teams to translate manufacturing requirements into software features, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
Participated in code reviews and followed SDLC best practices, improving code quality and reducing production defects by 20%.
